command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
[ -f "$change/proposal.md" ] || { echo "$record names change '$change_name', but $change/proposal.md does not exist - write the change there, or name the active change the task is about"; exit 1; }
verdict=$(sed -n 's/^Verdict:[[:space:]]*//p' "$record" | head -1)
if [ "$verdict" != "no-blocking-dependencies" ]; then
  echo "the change record's verdict is '$verdict'; the only verdict that finishes this stage is 'no-blocking-dependencies'."
  echo "If the change IS blocked, do not finish the round: write the dependency chain to the path in \$GNOMISH_DECISION_FILE as {\"question\": \"...\", \"options\": [\"...\"]}, delete $record and end your turn."
  exit 1
fi

findings.message: proposal.md M3 claims '100 % of the detection cases of the delta spec pass (digit counts 1, 11, 12, 14, 15, 17, 18, 22; ...)', but the delta spec specs/unix-time-converter/spec.md → 'Detection by digit count' has rows of 1, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 18 and 19 digits only — no 17-digit and no 22-digit case. The metric names cases the spec does not contain; add those rows to the spec table or correct M3.

proposal.md M2 requires three checks including 'the Chromium end-to-end scenario' showing «14:23:07.123» for `1795432987123` and «14:23:07.123456789» for `1795432987123456789` in the Moscow row, but no e2e scenario planned in tasks.md 9.8 asserts this ('Long values at 320 px' asserts the 12-hour «2:23:07.123456789 PM», the screenshots use only `1795432987123`). M2's third check has no task and no scenario.

The MODIFIED 'Settings page layout' requirement of specs/settings/spec.md adds the tools group to the one-row rule at 320/375/1024/2560 px and to scenario 'Compact groups' ('... and the tools group are each at most 56 px high'), tagged FR2, NFR-R1 of add-unix-time-converter-tool. No task updates the existing e2e scenario (settings_option_group_e2e.feature:72-76 'Compact groups', which checks only 'the theme group, the hour format group and the view group') or adds a step for the tools group: task 4.6 lists only 'Toggle group → Icon options' plus screenshots, and 3.4 only 'Place of the tools group'. test-planning.md: 'Every FR/NFR/UX from proposal must have at least one automated test covering it' and 'If a scenario is in Gherkin — it must have step definitions'.
